roleAbout.text: Allen was an IBM computer scientist whose work on optimizing compiler techniques and automatic parallel execution laid foundations for modern optimizing compilers. She was the first woman to receive the ACM A.M. Turing Award.

lesson.text: A compiler does not merely translate instructions: it reorganises them so a machine can do the same job more efficiently.
